stories.title: Visualize Knowledge/Performance Split in DOCX Contact Hour Tables
stories.description: Embed explicit 30% Knowledge / 70% Performance allocation visualization directly into the contact hour tables within generated DOCX files. Each work activity row must display the K/P breakdown to make learning outcome alignment visible for JPK reviewers.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify generate_docx.py contact hour table generation to add two columns: 'Knowledge (30%)' and 'Performance (70%)' alongside existing Activity, Hours, Code columns
Contact hour rows for each work activity in content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md show calculated hours for Knowledge and Performance (e.g., 30 hrs knowledge / 70 hrs performance for 100-hour activity)
Run `uv run scripts/generate_docx.py` produces output/NOSS-IT-020-{3,4,5}-*.docx with K/P columns visible and correctly summing to total contact hours per CoCu

stories.title: Build NOSS Compliance Audit Tool with JSON Reporting
stories.description: Create automated validation system that audits all 20 CoCu files against NOSS JPK compliance checklist. Generate JSON report with per-file status, enabling pre-submission gate and CI/CD integration for compliance verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/noss_audit.py that validates: (1) bilingual header tables present in all content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md, (2) assessment criteria sections exist, (3) contact hours mathematically correct, (4) all work activities have K/P allocation

CLI: `uv run scripts/noss_audit.py --output reports/compliance_audit.json` generates JSON with structure: {files: [{path, filename, validations: [{type, status, message}]}], summary: {total_files, passed_files, failed_files, pass_rate}}
Audit report identifies specific failures (e.g., 'IT-020-3/01_*.md missing Performance % in work activity row 3') with file:line references for remediation

stories.title: Extract Learning Outcomes and Validate Against 30/70 Framework
stories.description: Parse all work activities from 20 CoCu markdown files to extract learning outcomes and verify each explicitly allocates 30% Knowledge and 70% Performance. Generate validation report exposing any missing or incorrect allocations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/extract_learning_outcomes.py that parses content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md markdown, identifies work activity rows in contact hour tables, extracts learning outcome text and K/P percentages
Output CSV report to reports/learning_outcomes_validation.csv with columns: File, Activity, TotalHours, KnowledgeHours (30%), PerformanceHours (70%), Status (VALID/MISSING/INCORRECT)
CLI: `uv run scripts/extract_learning_outcomes.py` validates all 20 files; exits with code 0 if 100% valid, code 1 with error summary if any activity missing K/P allocation

stories.title: Validate CoCu Section Structure Against L3 CoCu 1 Gold Standard
stories.description: Enforce consistent section ordering and structure across all 20 CoCu files by comparing against content/IT-020-3/01_CoCu-1-Computer-System-Set-up.md as authoritative template. Flag structural deviations for remediation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/validate_structure.py that loads L3 CoCu 1 as reference, extracts section headers (##, ###, ####) and their order, compares structure across all content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md files
Detect violations: missing sections, wrong order, incorrect heading levels; output to reports/structure_violations.txt with format: 'File:Line: VIOLATION - Expected section X after Y, found Z'
CLI: `uv run scripts/validate_structure.py --reference content/IT-020-3/01_CoCu-1-Computer-System-Set-up.md` exits 0 if all 20 files match structure, exits 1 with violation count and details

stories.title: Generate Submission Manifest with SHA256 Integrity Verification
stories.description: Create submission package manifest documenting all 20 CoCu source files, generated DOCX outputs, and compliance audit reports with SHA256 checksums and metadata. Enable integrity verification and traceability for JPK/MySPIKE submission package.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/generate_manifest.py that walks content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md and output/*.docx, computes SHA256 hash for each file using hashlib, records: path, filename, hash, size_bytes, modified_timestamp

Output manifest to output/submission_manifest.json with structure: {generated_date, files: [{path, hash, size_bytes, modified_date}], summary: {total_files, source_count, docx_count, reports_count, manifest_version: '1.0'}}

CLI: `uv run scripts/generate_manifest.py --output output/submission_manifest.json` creates manifest; can verify with `uv run scripts/generate_manifest.py --verify output/submission_manifest.json` which re-hashes all files and reports mismatches
